categories.main_business_segments: ComNav Technology Ltd. primarily operates in high-precision GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) technology, focusing on the development and production of high-precision GNSS chips, modules, receivers, and data acquisition devices. The company also provides data application and system solutions, including ground-based augmentation systems, deformation and safety monitoring, and intelligent driving and digital construction systems. Additionally, it is expanding into emerging sectors such as unmanned farms, drones, intelligent driving, and IoT applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company independently develops high-precision GNSS chips integrating RF, baseband, and CPU functionalities using advanced 22nm process technology. It employs proprietary high-precision algorithms including RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) and PPP (Precise Point Positioning) for centimeter-level accuracy. The production involves strict R&D processes, quality control, and integration of multi-sensor fusion technologies such as inertial navigation, laser, and vision systems. The company also capitalizes R&D expenditures for chip and module development projects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers and integrators of GNSS receivers and terminals, government agencies, and enterprises in surveying and mapping, geographic information systems, intelligent transportation, deformation and safety monitoring, precision agriculture, autonomous driving, drones, and IoT sectors. Major end markets are professional fields requiring high-precision positioning and navigation, as well as emerging consumer and industrial applications globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: ComNav Technology Ltd. operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple subsidiaries across major Chinese cities. It has established an overseas subsidiary in Belgium to expand its global footprint. Its products and services are sold in over 140 countries and regions worldwide, including more than 50 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative corridor, covering Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas, Africa, and Oceania.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the high-precision satellite navigation industry chain. It designs and manufactures core GNSS chips and modules (upstream), produces GNSS receivers and data acquisition devices (midstream), and provides integrated system solutions and applications (midstream to downstream). It is also involved in system integration and application services in downstream markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in high-precision GNSS chipsets and modules, advancing multi-frequency, multi-constellation, and SoC integration technologies. The company focuses on expanding applications of 'BeiDou+' technology across industries, enhancing autonomous driving, unmanned systems, precision agriculture, and IoT. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 24% of revenue allocated to research, and actively participates in international and national standard setting for satellite navigation technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of high-precision GNSS chips, modules, receivers, and data acquisition devices. Additional income comes from providing customized data application and system integration solutions. The company employs a mix of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. It also benefits from government subsidies related to R&D and innovation projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ComNav Technology Ltd. is a leading domestic innovator and manufacturer in China's high-precision GNSS sector, holding approximately 25% market share in high-precision GNSS modules. It competes with international giants such as Trimble, NovAtel, and u-blox, and domestic peers like Hexin Xintong. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise, with a strong reputation for breaking foreign technology monopolies and achieving import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 412.9 million, a slight increase of 0.28% year-over-year. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 33 million, mainly due to increased R&D and sales expenses and credit impairment losses. Total assets grew by 6.88% to RMB 1.32 billion, while net assets decreased by 7.64% to RMB 946 million. The company maintains strong cash flow from operations, boosted by prepayments from major projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ComNav Technology Ltd. emphasizes its fully independent development of high-precision BeiDou/GNSS core technologies, including proprietary chips and algorithms, enabling high reliability and accuracy. Its products offer multi-constellation, multi-frequency support with advanced anti-interference capabilities and integration of multiple sensor technologies. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, participation in international standards, and a comprehensive product ecosystem serving diverse professional and emerging markets globally.
